still_unresolved: The global superiority of hanging-receptacle-first strategies for all cloth items in all bathroom layouts.
The optimal fallback order after missing a target on hanging receptacles (open surfaces vs. closed storage).

updates.evidence_basis: The agent followed the exploratory hypothesis to prioritize hanging receptacles (handtowelholder_1, handtowelholder_2) but failed to find the target cloth there. The cloth was subsequently found in a closed cabinet (cabinet_4), requiring navigation and opening actions. This contradicts the assumption that dedicated hanging spots are the primary or most efficient location for cloth acquisition in this instance.
updates.guidance: When searching for cloth items in bathrooms, do not assume dedicated hanging receptacles (towelholders/handtowelholders) are the primary location. If hanging receptacles are empty, immediately proceed to inspect open surfaces (countertops/sinks) before checking closed storage, as cloths may be stored in cabinets or left on counters rather than hung up.
updates.scope: ALFWorld bathroom tasks where the target object is a cloth item and dedicated hanging receptacles are visible but empty.
